# Copilot Instructions

1. Do not introduce new technologies without explicit approval.
2. Follow the existing folder structure.
3. Keep controllers thin.
4. Business logic belongs in services.
5. Database access belongs in repositories.
6. Validate all external input.
7. Never trust client-provided tenant identifiers for authorization.
8. Never expose secrets.
9. Never hardcode environment-specific configuration.
10. Reuse existing utilities before creating new ones.
11. Avoid duplicated business logic.
12. Write maintainable production-oriented code.
13. Do not implement features outside the requested scope.
14. Before making architectural changes, explain the impact.
15. Prefer small, reviewable changes.
16. Update relevant documentation when architecture changes.
